import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.HasseDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.Taylor
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.ToLinearEquiv
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Wronskian
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Vandermonde
import Mathlib.Data.ZMod.Defs
import Mathlib.Algebra.Field.ZMod
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Group.Int.Sum
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.Polynomial
import Mathlib.Algebra.Polynomial.CancelLeads
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.PDeriv
import Mathlib.Algebra.Order.Archimedean.Real.Basic
import Mathlib.Algebra.MvPolynomial.Equiv
import Mathlib.Analysis.Normed.Unbundled.RingSeminorm
import Mathlib.LinearAlgebra.Matrix.AbsoluteValue
import Mathlib.Data.Nat.Choose.Bounds
import Mathlib.RingTheory.Polynomial.Basic
#check_failure Roth.eval_diag
#check_failure Roth.diag
namespace MvPolynomial.EvalDiagRaw
variable {σ R S : Type*} [CommSemiring R] [CommSemiring S]
theorem generic (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (f : R →+* S) (x : S) :
    Polynomial.eval x (Polynomial.map f (aeval (fun _ ↦ Polynomial.X) P)) =
      eval (fun _ ↦ x) (map f P) := by
  rw [Polynomial.eval_map, aeval_def, ← eval₂_eq_eval_map]
  change (Polynomial.eval₂RingHom f x) (eval₂ Polynomial.C (fun _ ↦ Polynomial.X) P) = _
  rw [hom_eval₂, Polynomial.eval₂RingHom_comp_C]
  simp only [Polynomial.coe_eval₂RingHom, Polynomial.eval₂_X]
theorem abstract [Algebra R S] (P : MvPolynomial σ R) (x : S) :
    Polynomial.aeval x (aeval (fun _ ↦ Polynomial.X) P) = aeval (fun _ ↦ x) P := by
  simpa only [Polynomial.aeval_X] using
    (comp_aeval_apply (fun _ ↦ (Polynomial.X : Polynomial R)) (Polynomial.aeval x) P)
#check @MvPolynomial.hom_eval₂
#check @MvPolynomial.eval_map
#check @MvPolynomial.comp_aeval_apply
#check @Polynomial.eval₂RingHom_comp_C
#print axioms generic
#print axioms abstract
end MvPolynomial.EvalDiagRaw
